summary: Expose the Request-associated AbortSignal as a following signal rather than aliasing an input signal by object identity.

semantics.following: when init.signal is supplied the request signal follows its abort state/reason
semantics.identity: request.signal need not be the same object as init.signal

tests.name: request signal follows abort
tests.input: const c=new AbortController(); const r=new Request("https://e.test/",{signal:c.signal}); c.abort("why"); console.log(r.signal.aborted,r.signal.reason);

tests.name: request signal is distinct object
tests.input: const c=new AbortController(); const r=new Request("https://e.test/",{signal:c.signal}); console.log(r.signal===c.signal);
